name: Portainer
description: Browse Portainer environments, stacks and containers from DBX, inspect resource usage and read container logs, with MCP tools for AI clients.
releaseNotes: Adds an MCP tool surface: nine read-only tools for environments, stacks, containers, database discovery, container logs and resource stats, backed by a reusable MCP support package for other plugins.

zh-CN.name: Portainer
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 中浏览 Portainer 的环境、堆栈与容器，查看资源占用并阅读容器日志，同时向 AI 客户端提供 MCP 工具。
